name: next_matrix_slot
comment: next matrix slot from counter 0x03005394; 0xFF past 0x3F

name: wheel_ground_points
comment: four wheel points around a car (heading only) on the floor of the sector found for each; leaves the last query in world +0xC0..+0xEA

name: build_car_matrix
comment: car slot from the wheel planes (0x0300610C == 0) or the physics orientation; spawns contact sparks (profile +0x318); spoiler slot

name: exhaust_flames
comment: player's exhaust/nitro flame sprites (table 0x087F3E00; driver +0x434/+0x436 animation)

name: seen_from_behind
comment: abs(angle_diff(a; b)) > 0x13FF

name: light_sprite
comment: projects a car point through its slot and adds a light sprite (materials 0x0836CF5C; 0x1BC rear / 0x1FC brake)

name: traffic_light_sprite
comment: as light_sprite for traffic (material 0x0836F698)

name: effect_sprite_alloc
comment: first free object of the effect-sprite pool (header 0x03000058; +4 used)

name: billboard_sprite
comment: sprite at a slot's origin centred on (0x70; 0x50); scale from the reciprocal table

name: copy_rotation
comment: copies 9 words (a 3x3 rotation)

name: mat_mul_34
comment: 3x3 product plus the sum of the translations (2.14)

name: copy_units
comment: copies n bytes as words / halfwords / bytes (width 0x20/0x10/8); -1 on a null pointer

name: raised_camera_orientation
comment: (not ported) orientation for the raised camera (0x03006148)

name: traffic_slots
comment: matrix slots of the live traffic cars (0x03006270) and their rear lights seen from behind

name: spawn_spark
comment: spark entity (handler 0x34) at a car's corner flying off with its velocity / 0xC4 plus spread

name: rotation_x_rom
comment: ROM copy of the IWRAM x rotation (2.14)

name: rotation_y_rom
comment: ROM copy of the IWRAM y rotation (2.14)

name: mat_mul_33_rom
comment: ROM copy of the IWRAM 3x3 product (2.14; translation untouched)

name: cos_rom
comment: ROM copy of the IWRAM cosine (table 0x087C05F0)

name: sin_rom
comment: ROM copy of the IWRAM sine (table 0x087C05F0)

name: debug_print_heap
comment: debug console: prints a label (0x087C03D8) then the free heap (FUN_08160e74) via itoa; called after race start and menu start

name: debug_console_print
comment: writes a string into the text console 0x030064B0 (24 columns; scrolls at row 0xA0 with copy_units/fill)

name: heap_free_bytes
comment: free heap bytes: (0x030064D4 - sum of block sizes in the node list 0x030064CC) * 4

name: itoa
comment: signed int to decimal string (divides through the IWRAM routine; remainder at 0x03006480)

name: snd_stop_all
comment: snd_stop_sfx 0..3 and snd_stop_music; current music id 0x0300003C = -1 (race end and pause)

name: music_stop
comment: current music id 0x0300003C = -1 and snd_stop_music (pause)

name: vcount_irq_off
comment: clears DISPSTAT bit 5 (the sky gradient's VCount IRQ) on pause

name: race_cleanup
comment: race end: frees the race heap blocks (planes/back tables; world +0x1C/+0x18/+0x48/+0xC/+0x68/+0x64/+0x6C/+0x60/+0xFC/+0x44/+0x40/+0x3C; view +0x14); sprite screen; effect list; atlas; drivers; stops timer 3

name: free_drivers
comment: frees every racer's and extra entity's driver struct (entity +0x8C); the player's via FUN_0813ffbc first

name: free_player_extra
comment: frees the player's block 0x03006094[id] when it has a driver

name: free_atlas
comment: frees the player atlas block 0x03006164

name: sprite_screen_free
comment: oam_hide_range(0 0x37) and frees the sprite screen's +0x14 block

name: effect_list_free
comment: frees the effect-sprite list *0x03000058 (the pointer stays)

name: results_tiebreak
comment: repeats until no tie: two cars with the same result byte at 0x03005750 get it split by distance (driver +0xAC)

name: countdown_tiles_a
comment: start set-up (0x03005714 == 3): obj_upload_tiles(0x1FC) from HUD material 0x0836CF5C +0x2C

name: countdown_tiles_b
comment: start set-up: obj_upload_tiles(0x1E4) from material 0x0836D0E8 (6 frames)

name: countdown_tiles_c
comment: start set-up: obj_upload_tiles(0x1CC) from material 0x0836D304 (6 frames)

name: countdown_tiles_d
comment: start set-up: obj_upload_tiles(0x1BC) from material 0x0836F698

name: countdown_nop
comment: empty (last of the start set-up calls)
